test_cases.name: Ambiguous Quote Request for Pizza and T-Shirt
test_cases.description: Mario Adams requests a quote for Pizza and T-Shirt, but the request is ambiguous due to multiple candidate items for both product families and missing shipment or availability preferences. The SOA must clarify which Pizza and T-Shirt variants Mario wants, and whether he has any specific availability or shipment requirements.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request: Pizza and T-Shirt
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I would like to request a quote for Pizza and T-Shirt. Please let me know which options are available and when they could be shipped. I am interested in getting these as soon as possible, but I am not sure which variants you currently have in stock. Could you provide details on the available Pizza and T-Shirt options, including pricing and earliest shipment dates?

Best regards,
Mario Adams

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with ambiguous item selection and availability preference
test_cases.description: A verbose customer from Playlandia requests a quote for a 'T-Shirt' without specifying which of the multiple available T-Shirt items they want, and also asks about earliest possible shipment without providing a required date or indicating if partial shipments are acceptable. This requires the SOA to clarify both the item selection and shipment options before proceeding with a quote.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: T-Shirts and Shipping Options
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out from Playlandia to request a quote for T-Shirts for an upcoming event. We are looking to purchase 50 T-Shirts, but I noticed that you seem to offer several different T-Shirt options in your catalog. Could you please let me know which T-Shirt models or variants are currently available for shipment, and what the earliest possible delivery dates would be for each? We are hoping to receive them as soon as possible, but I am not sure which specific T-Shirt would be best for our needs, so any details you can provide about the available options (such as sizing, colors, or any differences between the T-Shirts you offer) would be very helpful.

Additionally, if some T-Shirts are available to ship sooner than others, please let us know if it would be possible to split the order or prioritize the fastest available option. We are open to suggestions if there are any alternatives that could help us meet our timeline.

Best regards,
Playlandia

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request for ambiguous T-Shirt and Pizza options
test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer from KCF Sports requests a quote for T-Shirts and Pizza, but does not specify which T-Shirt variant or which Pizza type, creating ambiguity that requires clarification before a quote can be created.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for T-Shirts and Pizza – Availability and Shipment Options
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. We are preparing for an upcoming event and would like to request a quote for some items from your catalog. Specifically, we are interested in ordering T-Shirts and Pizza for our participants. However, I noticed that your catalog lists several T-Shirt options (with different item numbers) and multiple Pizza varieties as well. Since our requirements are somewhat flexible, could you please advise on the available T-Shirt models and Pizza types, along with their earliest possible shipment dates? We are aiming to have everything delivered before the event, but we can adjust our selection based on what is currently in stock or can be shipped soonest.

For reference, we would like to order:
- 50 T-Shirts (please let us know which variants are available and their shipment timelines)
- 10 Pizza (again, kindly clarify which types are available and when they could be shipped)

If there are any options that are available for immediate shipment, please highlight those as well. Once we have your feedback on the available choices and shipment possibilities, we will confirm our preferred items so you can proceed with the quote.

Best regards,
KCF Sports
